purpose: Naturalistic context scattered around the explicit evaluation signals

messages.text: Raw note from beta review: Acme called the export flow fragile, Northstar said hard to trust, and Bellwether asked for an audit trail. These may be one reliability theme, not three requests.
Should a theme need evidence from three accounts before it enters the weekly brief? Prefer missing a weak signal over flooding the roadmap with noisy clusters.
The launch brief is assembled from call snippets, support tags and PM notes. The same objection appears under security, trust and governance.
Preserve links to the original call or thread in every generated insight. A summary without provenance will not be trusted by Sales.
Two prospects described the same pain differently: repeat discovery versus nobody remembers old experiments.
Enterprise buyers asked for the original discussion, owner and decision date instead of another dashboard screenshot.
A neutral-looking message from a large account sat for six hours; prior threads contained cancellation language that a single-message classifier missed.
Score urgency from current sentiment, account tier and recent conversation history, with human override.
Signal record includes source_ref, raw_text_hash, extracted_intent, author, observed_at, confidence_tier and matched_signal_id.
Use cosine retrieval to shortlist, then an LLM judge for exact, same-idea, tangential or no-match. Never notify on tangential.
